methods.name: f-DM
methods.relationship: 令 F_t=(1-lambda_t)I+lambda_t P、P=UD，并匹配 alpha/sigma，RDD 阶段内条件边缘分布是 f-DM 插值路径的具体选择。差别集中在投影、预测参数化/损失、SNR 和边界噪声耦合；边缘相同不代表整个采样器或训练完全相同。

literature_component_map.E_representation: 像素/变换空间；逐阶段单状态
literature_component_map.C_noise_marginal: σ²I；有 SP/VP 跨尺度 SNR 重标定
literature_component_map.K_coupling_boundary: 丢失噪声维度补采样；附录含平均噪声条件补全
literature_component_map.R_time_scale_allocation: 分段时间与变换 schedule
literature_component_map.T_W_target_loss: transformed clean + degradation 双目标；加权 MSE
literature_component_map.H_backbone: shared U-Net，按分辨率进入相应层
literature_component_map.S_solver_cost: 原版 DDPM/DDIM；匹配路径后再比较目标

methods.name: Edify Image
methods.relationship: RDD mean = alpha P x + alpha(1-lambda)(I-P)x，恰是两频带独立衰减形式。匹配投影、band schedule 和 noise schedule 可得到同一阶段边缘路径；实际 VP/EDM 参数化、损失预条件和跨尺度 coupling 仍不同。

literature_component_map.A_signal_path: 各 band 单独 α_j(t)；RDD 是可匹配的两带实例
literature_component_map.C_noise_marginal: EDM/各带幅度；尺度 s 时 σ→sσ
literature_component_map.K_coupling_boundary: 保留 coarse noisy state，补正交高带噪声
literature_component_map.R_time_scale_allocation: 高带先消失，再压缩状态
literature_component_map.H_backbone: 可单模型/专家；实际 suite 多模型
literature_component_map.S_solver_cost: 计入 base 与高分辨率模型，不能只比 head

literature_component_map.A_signal_path: 块内 heat/DCT blur 连续路径
literature_component_map.C_noise_marginal: IID plus overlapping cyclic rolling-window noise; not block-constant repetition.

literature_component_map.R_time_scale_allocation: 低尺度生成后交接给高尺度

literature_component_map.K_coupling_boundary: 保留低频系数；新频率补 Gaussian
literature_component_map.R_time_scale_allocation: 由功率谱与误差容忍度决定 schedule
literature_component_map.T_W_target_loss: training-free 不改；FT 适配 progressive 输入
literature_component_map.S_solver_cost: 需与同 pretrained checkpoint 的方法比较

methods.native_scope: Full released FLUX generation and local random VAE; DCT/Haar/FFT expansion, bf16, decoded pixels.
methods.compatibility_and_limits: Inference-only release. Author FlowMatch scheduler backend explicitly reused. NumPy fp32 scaling precedes destination cast; native non-Hermitian FFT real-part behavior and RNG order retained. No unpublished fine-tuning recipe claimed.

preimplementation_review.review: Inference-only public release. DCT/Haar/FFT spectral expansion uses NumPy per-leading-index RNG order, float32, scipy/pywt, kappa=r/(1+(r-1)t), aligned t=t*kappa. Public time is noise-oriented. FFT takes real part of non-Hermitian coefficients; do not replace with a different Hermitian noise coupling under an exact-native claim.

methods.name: PixelFlow
methods.relationship: 共享模型、逐阶段 coarse-to-fine、up/down residual 都很近；RDD-FM 的 drift 系数为 b(t)=t*(b-t)/(b-a)，因此信号 mean 关于全局 t 有二次项；PixelFlow 两 endpoint 的直线 mean 对 tau 为一次，通常不逐点相同。

literature_component_map.E_representation: 原版像素；逐阶段合成状态
literature_component_map.A_signal_path: noisy coarse/fine endpoints 间的分段直线
literature_component_map.C_noise_marginal: 阶段内共用 ε，noise amplitude 1−t

literature_component_map.T_W_target_loss: 局部 τ endpoint velocity；转换全局 t 要除 L
literature_component_map.S_solver_cost: 同 P/表示的版本是路径移植，不是原版

Native 2x2 block Gaussian has diagonal epsilon jitter 1e-6; iterative sampling is CPU. Scheduler rounds state and dt to fp32. Packed training requires FlashAttention; provide isolated CPU SDPA varlen replacement and quantify kernel difference.

Delayed per-band data alpha=(t-a)/(1-a), sigma=1-t; global-time velocities. MoT forward final_layers uses the final loop i for all outputs (preserve native behavior explicitly, optional corrected-head transplant). CUDA-only time tensors need device compatibility.

methods.relationship: 概率路径并不与 RDD 相同，但能隔离减少早期 token 的贡献。若不优于这类对照，仅比固定分辨率 DiT 好不足以证明 drift 价值。

methods.native_scope: Actual PPFlow DiT, 2/3 stages, invertible channel-to-space and width permutation, velocity loss and entire Euler trajectories.
methods.compatibility_and_limits: Balanced batch must divide by 2/4. Native strict rejection mode can undersupply; expected error retained. learn_sigma=False has a source unpatchify channel bug; source-default True retained, variance output ignored by FM. num_steps counts endpoints, hence n-1 updates.

preimplementation_review.review: Invertible channel-spatial permutation preserves all state dimensions; NOT lossy downsampling. 2/3 stages include width-only layout. No renoising. Ordinary FM in permuted coordinates with global-time target, native packed heterogeneous batches and separate patch heads. Native rejection time sampling may return too few samples for tiny batches; expose both exact-native sampler and an explicitly labeled direct-stratified replacement.

review: Two optimizers: fake score phase1 followed by generator phase2 using freshly updated fake score. Frozen real teacher, CFG in clean coordinates.
Ordinary RF velocity conversions clean=z-sigma*v and predicted_noise=z+(1-sigma)*v.
Sampler draws and discards initial index random draw, reinjects pure fresh Gaussian exactly at resolution switch; eta predicted/fresh mixture at other steps.
Spatial bilinear flatten B*T, source target geometry replaced only by small local random-Wan fixture.
Source adaptive normalization reduces axes [1,2,3], leaving width for BCTHW: preserve this released behavior; do not silently substitute per-example norm.
Source score weighting float64 then float32; pseudo-Huber normalization depends on C*T*H*W, not batch.
Native top timestep980 and scheduler train_steps1000 retained. Optional GAN omitted as released experimental branch, no text encoder or weights downloads.
